# Synthetic Route Report

An early bulletin described the route as safe in all weather.

After a later inspection, the route was closed during extreme heat. The updated
guidance applies only when temperatures exceed the posted threshold.

A participant still described the route as comfortable on a cool morning. That
quotation reflects one person's experience, not the updated safety policy.
